action.description: Stable action identifier, for example `artifact.create` or `agent.session.open`.

actor.description:
Actor is always present on the wire; `null` is used before an authenticated adapter binds
an external principal.

deadline.description: Absolute Unix timestamp in milliseconds by which the action must complete.

route_generation.description:
Route generation is always present on the wire; `null` is used for actions without a
Gateway route fence.

session_generation.description: Session generation is always present on the wire; `null` is used for pre-session actions.

tenant_scope.description:
Tenant scope is always present on the wire; `null` is used for actions that are not
tenant-scoped.

AgentResourceLifecycleScope.description:
Complete Volume-local scope carried only on the Central-to-Agent lifecycle delivery.

Public lifecycle APIs intentionally use the smaller [`ResourceRef`]. The delivery expands that
reference with the immutable placement identity needed to derive filesystem paths and reject a
stale or cross-Volume cleanup command.

Creates the server-derived Playground directory below the approved Agent mount.

This operation deliberately reuses the normal job accepted/progress/failed reports. It
does not enter the managed-Add publication state machine: successful materialization is
terminal after the Agent reports `job.progress(state=succeeded)`.
Materializes one immutable Snapshot delivery using the selected read-only mode.
